svg.text: Radial distribution of the hydrogen 1s electron: P(r) = 4x^2 e^{-2x}, x = r/a0
Density |psi|^2 is largest at the nucleus, but P(r) = 4 pi r^2 |psi|^2 is zero there: a shell of radius r has volume.
The 32.3 % inside a0 and the 23.8 % beyond 2 a0 come from P(r <= R) = 1 - e^{-2x}(1 + 2x + 2x^2), x = R/a0.
